recipe-section-1.markdown:
- **Butter**: 250 g ([**7:58**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=478s))
- **All-purpose flour**: 120 g ([**8:30**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=510s))
- **Onion**: 1 large (rough chopped) ([**1:30**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=90s))
- **Celery stalks**: 2 stalks (or approx. 500 g, rough chopped) ([**1:39**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=99s))
- **Garlic**: 1 whole head (pressed) ([**9:20**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=560s))
recipe-section-1.html:
• Butter: 250 g (7:58)
  • All-purpose flour: 120 g (8:30)
  • Onion: 1 large (rough chopped) (1:30)
  • Celery stalks: 2 stalks (or approx. 500 g, rough chopped) (1:39)
  • Garlic: 1 whole head (pressed) (9:20)
recipe-section-1.title: The Base & Vegetables

recipe-section-2.markdown:
- **Chicken**: 1 whole chicken (Aaron specifically uses 4 legs and 4 thighs with bones left on) ([**7:12**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=432s))
- **Sausage**: Traditional Andouille or local alternative (cut diagonally) ([**3:17**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=197s))
- **Chicken stock**: 2.366 L (added incrementally) ([**15:18**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=918s))
recipe-section-2.html:
• Chicken: 1 whole chicken (Aaron specifically uses 4 legs and 4 thighs with bones left on) (7:12)
  • Sausage: Traditional Andouille or local alternative (cut diagonally) (3:17)
  • Chicken stock: 2.366 L (added incrementally) (15:18)
recipe-section-2.title: Meat & Liquids

recipe-section-3.markdown:
- **Chicken bouillon cube**: 1 cube ([**16:46**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=1006s))
- **Creole seasoning (e.g., Tony Chachere's)**: 59 mL ([**17:24**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=1044s))
- **Slap Ya Mama Cajun seasoning**: 59 mL ([**17:17**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=1037s))
- **Garlic powder**: 29.5 mL ([**16:46**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=1006s))
- **Onion powder**: 29.5 mL ([**16:46**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=1006s))
- **Garlic flakes**: 29.5 mL ([**16:31**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=991s))
- **White pepper**: 29.5 mL ([**16:46**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=1006s))
- **Red chili flakes**: 29.5 mL ([**16:22**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=982s))
- **Steak seasoning (or all-purpose seasoning)**: 29.5 mL ([**17:06**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=1026s))
- **Sea salt**: A pinch ([**17:06**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=1026s))

*(Note: Aaron starts with half quantities of the seasonings during the video, tastes it, and then adds 15 mL of everything to boost the liquid's final flavor profile (*[***17:45***](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=1065s)*)).*
recipe-section-3.html:
• Chicken bouillon cube: 1 cube (16:46)
  • Creole seasoning (e.g., Tony Chachere's): 59 mL (17:24)
  • Slap Ya Mama Cajun seasoning: 59 mL (17:17)
  • Garlic powder: 29.5 mL (16:46)
  • Onion powder: 29.5 mL (16:46)
  • Garlic flakes: 29.5 mL (16:31)
  • White pepper: 29.5 mL (16:46)
  • Red chili flakes: 29.5 mL (16:22)
  • Steak seasoning (or all-purpose seasoning): 29.5 mL (17:06)
  • Sea salt: A pinch (17:06) 

(Note: Aaron starts with half quantities of the seasonings during the video, tastes it, and then adds 15 mL of everything to boost the liquid's final flavor profile (17:45)).
recipe-section-3.title: Seasonings & Spices

recipe-section-5.markdown: Give a very rough hand-chop to your onion and celery stalks so they leave thick, rustic chunks in your gumbo ([**0:13**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=13s)). Slice your sausages at a diagonal angle ([**4:52**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=292s)). Prepare your chicken pieces by separating the legs and thighs, keeping the bones intact for extra flavor ([**7:12**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=432s)).
recipe-section-5.html: Give a very rough hand-chop to your onion and celery stalks so they leave thick, rustic chunks in your gumbo (0:13). Slice your sausages at a diagonal angle (4:52). Prepare your chicken pieces by separating the legs and thighs, keeping the bones intact for extra flavor (7:12).
recipe-section-5.title: Step 1: Chop the Veggies and Meat
recipe-section-5.heading_html: Step 1: Chop the Veggies and Meat

recipe-section-6.markdown: Turn on your Instant Pot's high-heat sauté function ([**5:25**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=325s)). Melt 250 g of butter and stir in 120 g of all-purpose flour ([**7:58**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=478s)). Stand over the pot and stir constantly for roughly 7 minutes until the mixture turns into a rich, chocolatey golden-brown color ([**5:33**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=333s)). *Do not walk away, or it will burn (*[***9:26***](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=566s)*)!*
recipe-section-6.html: Turn on your Instant Pot's high-heat sauté function (5:25). Melt 250 g of butter and stir in 120 g of all-purpose flour (7:58). Stand over the pot and stir constantly for roughly 7 minutes until the mixture turns into a rich, chocolatey golden-brown color (5:33). Do not walk away, or it will burn (9:26)!
recipe-section-6.title: Step 2: Cook the Roux

recipe-section-7.markdown: Carefully dump your chopped onion and celery directly into the hot roux ([**12:28**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=748s)). The natural moisture and acids from the vegetables will react with the oil and safely deglaze any flour clinging to the bottom of the pot ([**11:22**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=682s)).
recipe-section-7.html: Carefully dump your chopped onion and celery directly into the hot roux (12:28). The natural moisture and acids from the vegetables will react with the oil and safely deglaze any flour clinging to the bottom of the pot (11:22).
recipe-section-7.title: Step 3: Deglaze with Vegetables

recipe-section-8.markdown: Pour in 473 mL of your chicken stock to keep the vegetables cooking down and lower the heat ([**13:26**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=806s)). Use a garlic press to crush a whole head of garlic directly into the mix ([**9:20**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=560s)).
recipe-section-8.html: Pour in 473 mL of your chicken stock to keep the vegetables cooking down and lower the heat (13:26). Use a garlic press to crush a whole head of garlic directly into the mix (9:20).
recipe-section-8.title: Step 4: Build the Liquid Base

recipe-section-9.markdown: Drop your bone-in chicken pieces and sliced sausages straight into the pot ([**14:59**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=899s)). Pour in the remaining 1.893 L of chicken stock, making sure to scrape the bottom to ensure nothing sticks ([**15:18**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=918s)).
recipe-section-9.html: Drop your bone-in chicken pieces and sliced sausages straight into the pot (14:59). Pour in the remaining 1.893 L of chicken stock, making sure to scrape the bottom to ensure nothing sticks (15:18).
recipe-section-9.title: Step 5: Add the Proteins

recipe-section-10.markdown: Add your bouillon cube, Cajun seasonings, garlic powder, onion powder, garlic flakes, white pepper, red chili flakes, steak seasoning, and sea salt ([**16:31**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=991s)). Stir deeply to make sure the seasoning completely incorporates into the liquid ([**17:34**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=1054s)).
recipe-section-10.html: Add your bouillon cube, Cajun seasonings, garlic powder, onion powder, garlic flakes, white pepper, red chili flakes, steak seasoning, and sea salt (16:31). Stir deeply to make sure the seasoning completely incorporates into the liquid (17:34).
recipe-section-10.title: Step 6: Season Heavily

recipe-section-11.markdown: Secure the lid of your Instant Pot ([**18:14**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=1094s)). Cook under pressure for 30 to 35 minutes ([**18:28**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=1108s)). This rapid-cooking step locks in all the deep flavors that traditionally take hours on a stove ([**5:51**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=351s)).
recipe-section-11.html: Secure the lid of your Instant Pot (18:14). Cook under pressure for 30 to 35 minutes (18:28). This rapid-cooking step locks in all the deep flavors that traditionally take hours on a stove (5:51).
recipe-section-11.title: Step 7: Pressure Cook

recipe-section-12.markdown: Carefully vent and open the Instant Pot ([**18:50**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=1130s)). Serve hot over a bed of white rice ([**19:20**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWmCDa1q7ls&t=1160s)).
recipe-section-12.html: Carefully vent and open the Instant Pot (18:50). Serve hot over a bed of white rice (19:20).
recipe-section-12.title: Step 8: Serve
